summary_en: Pronexus will acquire up to 1 million shares (4.05% of outstanding shares) at 1,038 yen per share via ToSTNeT-3 on November 2, 2026, for a maximum total of 1.038 billion yen.
title_en: Notice Regarding Acquisition of Treasury Stock and Purchase of Treasury Stock via Off-Hours Trading (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief:
On October 30, 2026, Pronexus announced the execution of a treasury stock acquisition via off-hours trading (ToSTNeT-3). The company will purchase up to 1 million shares of common stock at the closing price of 1,038 yen as quoted on October 30, 2026. The transaction will be executed on November 2, 2026, during the morning session of the Tokyo Stock Exchange off-hours trading window.

The maximum acquisition cost is capped at 1.038 billion yen. Based on the company's disclosure of 24,708,727 outstanding shares (excluding treasury stock) as of September 30, 2026, the 1 million shares represent 4.1% of outstanding shares. The purchase order is valid only during the specified trading session, and the company reserves the right not to execute part or all of the acquisition depending on market conditions.

The company stated that the acquisition is intended to improve capital efficiency, implement flexible capital policies responsive to changes in the operating environment, and provide enhanced returns to shareholders. Results of the acquisition will be announced after the close of the trading session on November 2, 2026.
